name: Ossian Tremaine-Yeboah
description: Ossian Tremaine-Yeboah is a Tier 4 native who became notorious not for exposing injustice but for broadcasting the interior life of Tier 4 comfort with surgical, unflattering honesty — his feed documents the boredom, moral numbness, and petty cruelties of corporate comfort class in real time, including his own. His handle is 'CONFESSION BOOTH' and his audience is split almost equally between Tier 1-2 viewers who watch for class rage catharsis and Tier 4 viewers who watch with the specific discomfort of being accurately described. He has been dropped by four corporate sponsors and picked up by three others who believe controversy is marketable, a cycle he documents on the feed itself. His geneware modifications are conspicuously minimal — a statement in a social class where heavy modification is expected.
cultural_impact: Ossian's feed has created an uncomfortable cross-tier dialogue that no corporate media intended to facilitate — his Tier 4 audience's discomfort is visible and public, and his Tier 1-2 audience's responses are increasingly organized rather than merely reactive. Social critics call him either the most important voice in GLMZ or the most elaborate act of class tourism ever broadcast.
key_figures: Ingrid Papadopoulos-Mwangi (his Tier 4 social circle, frequently broadcast without full consent)
Broker Saul Achterberg-Diallo (his current corporate sponsor, who is beginning to regret the arrangement)
locations: The Meridian Collective, Tier 4 residential social club
Studio Null, his private broadcast space in Tier 3
The Overlap, a Tier 2-3 border bar where he occasionally appears unannounced
story_hooks: Ossian's feed has captured something his Tier 4 social circle insists was private — a conversation implicating several of them in a financial arrangement that constitutes fraud. His 'friends' are now pressuring him to pull the archive, and some of them have corporate legal teams.

A Tier 1 activist collective wants to use Ossian's cross-tier reach to broadcast a specific message, but they don't trust his motives — is he a genuine ally or will he document their movement as another exhibit in his gallery of human failure?
Ossian has gone dark for 11 days — no feed, no contact — and both his corporate sponsors and his Underworld-connected viewers are looking for him for very different reasons.
platform: CONFESSION BOOTH Neural Feed (currently hosted on Helix Media, a Tier 4 corporate platform)
follower_count: 145 million, unusually evenly distributed across tiers 1 through 4
controversy: In 2218, Ossian broadcast a real-time feed of a Tier 4 charity gala where the actual donation processing was visible — the gala raised Φ 4.2 million, of which Φ 310,000 reached the stated Shelf beneficiaries. He said nothing during the broadcast. The silence was the statement.
